name: engenharia-de-requisitos
description: Loads canonical knowledge of Requirements Engineering, Business Analysis, and Professional Ethics into any Claude session — built from the IFPB ERS course (Prof. Dr. Juliana Dantas Ribeiro Viana de Medeiros) plus the canonical bibliography (Sommerville, Pressman, Wiegers, Cohn, Robertson, Hull, Falbo, BABOK v3, SBC 002/2024). Bilingual (en-CA default + full pt-BR). For the stage BEFORE code (discover what to build) and AFTER (validate it was built right): elicitation, user stories, acceptance criteria, BDD, EARS, Planning Poker, dependability/security NFRs, traceability, and an on-disk docs/ spine.
